messages.subject: stat_quantile with confidence interval
parts:
Dear all,

Is there an easy way to produce a plot of a quantile regression with
confidence intervals for the slope?

I'm using stat_quantile() which I believe uses functions from the
'quantreg' package, which can return intervals with its predict
method. I can fit the model and produce predicted values separately
with the quantreg package and then build a plot with layers, but is
there an easier way?

Thanks

Andy.
